WELCOME TO THE STORE

This is the parts store behind MECHA // BLOCKS: custom LEGO® mecha MOCs, modeled and rendered with open source tools and inspired by anime, science fiction and video games.

Every model on the site comes with an interactive 3D viewer, a parts list and building instructions - preview a build there, then pick up its pieces here.
